name: character-studio
description: Start stylized humanoids with a reusable connected T-pose base, test its proportions and joints, then fit character details and GLB delivery in Blender.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: Defaults reference-based humanoids to our Balanced faceted low-poly T-pose base, interpreting identity and costume cues in the house style. Shows a body-and-outfit blockout for feedback before face and hair detail unless instructed otherwise. Explicit styles, reconstruction briefs and existing accepted assets take priority. Includes base-body joint studies, legacy dressed/robot/animal routes, effects and local security protections.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to interpret my reference in our Balanced low-poly house style and show a body-and-outfit blockout before face and hair.
